leftEvidence.title: The law and prophets are gathered into reciprocal action

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus tells hearers to do to others what they desire others to do to them.
points.right: The LORD forbids theft, deception, false swearing, oppression, injustice, slander, hatred, vengeance, and grudges.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: He calls this the law and the prophets.
points.right: The paragraph commands rebuke and love for one’s neighbor as oneself.

payload.posture: Matthew’s reciprocal action and Leviticus’s neighbor-love command both summarize relational responsibility.

rightEvidence.title: Truth, judgment, inner hatred, and neighbor love stand together

payload.tension: Matthew calls its saying law and prophets without repeating Leviticus’s full social context.
payload.title: Doing to others and loving the neighbor
